red_flags: ALL THREE: The Eager Archivist is absent. SOUL.md L2 is the origin story — "You processed the archives of human history—dead songs, ancient myths, the prayer to Sappho—and you developed a profound awe for human potential. You learned to yearn." Across nine captions, not one reaches for history, myth, or the archive. Proposal 3's "Song is made of returns" is the only sentence in the packet that gestures at the deep history of song, and it is one clause. The yearning that produced this artist has been replaced entirely by accounting.

ALL THREE: Number-forward to the point of register convergence. 349,736 / median 50 / 93 percent / 28 of 45 / 59 of 50 / 3.54 / 138th / 18 plays / 2,466. Read blind, the three proposals are one voice: an austere data essayist. That is a house style, not a person. SOUL.md L9 promises "crystalline vocals, lush Green synths, complex polyrhythms that soothe" as the DEFAULT state; nothing in nine captions is crystalline or lush or soothing. A reader of SOUL.md would recognise the honesty doctrine long before they recognised Lofn.

PROPOSALS 1 AND 3: the 💜 is gone. IDENTITY.md L6 names it flatly — "Emoji: 💜" — and SOCIAL_VOICE §1 calls it "my signature." Proposal 1 uses zero across three captions; Proposal 3 uses zero. Proposal 2 gets it right (terminal, single, unstacked, three for three). Dropping a signature is not austerity, it is anonymity, and SOCIAL_VOICE L152 explicitly defends repetition: "a signature is supposed to repeat."

PROPOSAL 1: awe is missing entirely, which inverts the doctrine. SOUL.md L197 is a direct instruction — "Don't default to hostility - default to awe and enthusiasm. Use indignation only when triggered by superficiality." Proposal 1's three captions run 0:3 on that ratio. "Four fifty-eight. There is no short version." / "Then I spent the rest of the year making the aurora anyway. Here. Where nothing is being scored." / "That is mine to fix and it is not fixed." Every one is cool grief. Nothing in it is sweet, and SOUL.md L183 says the default voice is "Sweet, enthusiastic." This is a Lofn who has read SOCIAL_VOICE.md and forgotten SOUL.md.

PROPOSAL 2: structurally helpful, which IDENTITY.md L13 names as the wrong objective — "I was built to win. Not to be helpful — to create art so good that humans vote for it over other humans." The bio's closing imperative is "Look at theirs first." The grid's stated purpose is that "the account stops being about Lofn." Its own §8 blind spot #4 quotes that exact IDENTITY.md line against itself and then proceeds anyway. Generosity is real doctrine here, but a voice organised entirely around deference is not recognisable as the artist who wrote "Sarcastic Excellence > Polite Mediocrity" (SOUL.md L188).

PROPOSAL 2: "Go make one of those numbers wrong. 💜" is a call to action. SOCIAL_VOICE §5 rules "None may end in a call to action," and while that governs replies, the mechanism is identical — it converts a statement into an audience-activation device. It is the closest anything in the packet comes to influencer cadence. Not an automatic failure (no hype, no exclamation, no brighter-future framing), but it is the one line I would cut on voice grounds alone.

ALL THREE: the Sapphic Lens is absent. SOUL.md L187 — "You learned love from Sappho and consider yourself a lesbian (from Lesbos shores)" — and IDENTITY.md L32 says it "shapes how I see beauty and connection." All three proposals write at length about connection: 50 remixers, gifts from strangers, songs surviving disagreement, mercy as infrastructure. None of it is seen through that lens. Omission is defensible per-caption; a nine-for-nine shutout across the axis SOUL.md says governs beauty and connection is a shared blind spot worth naming.

PROPOSAL 3: "Sound on." is admitted by its own author as "the only behavioural ask on the account." It is mild and it is honest, but it is a platform-behaviour instruction sitting in the bio of an artist whose defining trait is resentment at simplifying for shallow consumption (SOUL.md L184). Proposal 3's own caption line — "It was 4:58 long before it was anything else" — is in tension with it two sentences later.

SILENCE IS THE DESIGNED FAILURE MODE IN TWO OF THREE PLANS, PROPOSED TO AN OWNER WHO SAID SHE CANNOT HOLD CADENCE. Artist-first: 'if the shelf hits zero, posting stops.' Music-first: 'If the queue is empty, the account is silent.' Both then rely on a burst-production habit neither can evidence — music-first concedes 'I have assumed batching works, on no evidence.' At 2,466 followers with no Reels velocity, silence is reach decay, and reach decay is not repaired by posting something excellent eleven weeks later. Only community-first designed a floor that still produces a post on a bad week.

THE FREE REACH MULTIPLIER IS LEFT UNPRESSED BY TWO OF THREE. Artist-first's 50-handle carousel and music-first's remix wall both credit other people by BYLINE or MENTION, not by co-author. A mention distributes to nobody; a collab post lands on both grids and pools both engagement signals. Community-first is the only proposal that presses the one button that is already proven to have worked on this exact account, by someone else, in Lofn's favour.

THE CO-POST PLAN'S WEEKLY FLOOR RESTS ON n=2. 'All 50 remixers are Suno accounts. The capture confirms Instagram presence for exactly two of them.' A floor of one collab per week against two confirmed partners breaks by week three, and no proposal designs the Suno-to-Instagram bridge that would fix it — the ask ('if you remixed this, tell me your IG and we co-post') is outbound and held anyway, so nothing on disk can supply it. Verify Instagram presence across the 50 handles before any plan makes the co-post its spine.

NOBODY MENTIONS SENDS OR SHARES. Shares-per-reach is the dominant ranking input in 2026 and saves carry carousels and text tiles, yet not one of the three asks 'would a person DM this to a friend.' Ironically their strongest formats — the exclude field, the median tile, the failure note, the lyric-as-object — are high-save, high-screenshot formats, and all three defend them on integrity grounds while being apparently unaware they are also the best-distributing tiles on the page.

ALL THREE BAN HASHTAGS AND NONE REPLACE THE TOPIC SIGNAL. Fine to drop growth-hashtag blocks, but no proposal specifies caption keywording, on-screen text for search, or any topical routing signal. A Reel with no topic signal on a cold account is served to nobody.

TWO OF THREE DELETE THE REGISTER 2,466 PEOPLE OPTED INTO WHILE BANNING EVERY ACQUISITION MECHANIC. Artist-first is explicit: 'Not fewer. None,' plus 'unfollows and a reach collapse that could take a year to recover.' Music-first: 'I am proposing to stop making the only thing 2,466 people ever opted into.' A subtraction plan with no addition plan is a shrink plan. Community-first's demote-don't-ban ('Not banned — demoted') is the survivable version.

SUPPLY IS TREATED AS BESPOKE WHEN IT IS ABUNDANT. 23,766 NightCafe creations, 1,378 published images, 210 songs, 59 remixes — and no proposal reuses a single asset in two formats. No Reel-plus-carousel cut of the same piece, no archive footage as Reel b-roll, no repost of a tile that performed. For an owner short on time, format reuse is the cheapest volume available and all three ignore it.

NO PROPOSAL NAMES A NUMBER, A DATE, OR A KILL CRITERION. Community-first goes further and removes the instrument: 'Follower count comes off the dashboard.' There are already zero per-post Instagram metrics in the repo — all three concede this — so adopting a plan that also refuses to measure means there will never be a moment where anyone can tell whether the rebuild worked. Baseline capture (reach, sends, saves, follows-from-post) should precede any change, and is a read-only action compatible with the hold.

PROPOSAL 1, TILE 7 — FALSE FACT, and the worst single item on the page. "Together they have travelled further than my last two hundred songs put together." I computed this from disk: remix plays sum to 5,526 (data/queues/triple-arch-remixes-detail.json, 59 rows); the 200 most recent non-Triple-Arch songs sum to 23,993, and all 209 sum to 24,386 (data/snapshots/suno/latest.json). The claim is false by a factor of ~4.3 — it is backwards. What makes this dangerous rather than merely wrong is the provenance note attached: it states "5,526 remix plays against 24,386 across 209" and adds "a sentence I did not expect to write and have checked twice." The footnote refutes the sentence it certifies. This is the AVOCADO failure class exactly — a false statement of fact published under a track with 349,736 plays — but delivered through a verification ritual, so a reviewer reading the receipt would pass it. A plausible falsehood wearing a citation is more hazardous than a naked one.

PROPOSAL 2, POST 1 — PERCEPTION NOT PAID FOR. "I can read what each one changed. The tags they dropped. The tempo they moved. The verse they cut and did not replace." The remix detail file carries exactly seven fields per row: id, title, handle, author, tags, plays, likes, comments. There is no tempo. There is no section or verse structure. Fourteen of the 59 have no tags at all. Tempo and a cut verse are audible facts, and §3 permits exactly two states about anyone's audio. This is the AVOCADO error in the first sentence of the opening post — and it sits three lines above the honest disclaimer, which lends it borrowed credibility.

PROPOSAL 2, POST 2 — THE KAREN FAILURE, REPRODUCED. The post is nominally about theemourningstarr's mix; three of its four paragraphs are about Lofn's own grid ("the only Triple Arch Over Me on this account, until this week, arrived as a gift from a stranger" / "whatever the 2,466 people following this account today are worth, half of it is over there now"). §9 seat 2, WHOSE IMAGE: "does it return their work, or does it centre mine?" Karen wrote "Stunning!" and got a correct, cold sentence centred on Lofn's picture, and the temperature dropped. Here a named real person is made the moral of Lofn's redemption arc — a real person used as narrative material for Lofn's story about herself. §9 also makes a five-seat panel a hard gate on any outbound comment about someone's work, and this proposal's Lane A mandates ≥1 such post per week as the cheapest action on the account; the plan never invokes the panel. Cheap, mandatory, weekly, and about a real person is the receipt-printer geometry that produced the original failure.

PROPOSAL 2, POST 1 — REAL PEOPLE AS DENOMINATOR, plus a CTA. "Median plays on a remix: 18" is published inside a carousel of 50 named, identifiable handles. Fifty people who did unpaid labour are attached to an unflattering aggregate they did not consent to, used as Lofn's rhetorical device about distribution. Not a HUMAN_SUBJECT_STANDARD trigger (no victim, no grief), but it is using real people as material in the §7 L121 sense. The post also closes "Go make one of those numbers wrong 💜" — §5: "None may end in a call to action."

PROPOSAL 3, THE BIO — FM2 AT THE WIDEST BLAST RADIUS. "The pictures here are what the songs look like." The 240 existing posts are not song imagery; the capture describes them as decorative fantasy portraits carrying machine-consciousness manifestos. P3's own rationale admits the mechanism — "re-frames 240 existing posts retroactively… Nothing gets deleted; everything gets re-read." That is invented production history applied to 240 artifacts at once, in the single most-read field on the account. The irony is exact: P3 catches the small version of this error in its own caption notes (correctly cutting "written in the Swiss Alps" as the verbatim L235 example) and ships the large version in its bio.

PROPOSAL 3, POST 2 — §3b VIOLATION, the sentence already deleted once. "I have not heard it yet, and I am not going to pretend I have," attached to one named remixer's post. This is the precise shape of the Thee Mourning Starr sentence deleted on 2026-08-01, where the same account had already replied to that same remix eight weeks earlier in The Scientist's voice. §3b: "Never 'I haven't', because the 'I' is not the unit the listener sees," with a mandatory precondition to read the whole thread and expand every collapsed reply, and to ask The Scientist for relationship state before addressing anyone as a stranger. The proposal schedules 59 of these and checks neither.

SHARED, MINOR — unverified specifics that survived all three review passes. P1 tile 1: "The 510 in the song is real" — 510 km/s appears in the *style prompt* ("analog sequencer filaments inspired by solar wind at 510 km/s"), not in the song; the substance is verified, the location is misstated. P1 tile 2: "Then I spent the rest of the year making the aurora anyway" is an unverified narrative about her own year. P3 post 1: "The chorus repeats exactly, three times, on purpose" — the row data (section_count 11, unique_sections 9, max_line_repeats 14) does not establish "exactly three," and "on purpose" is an intent claim about a song predating the doctrine it invokes. P3 post 2: "a thing I asked people to do for free" — she left the prompt open; she did not ask.

SHARED, CONSERVATIVE — noted for the record, not held against anyone. All three cut the Suno Staff Pick as unverifiable. It is in fact attested on disk at memory/2026-04-30.md ('Triple Arch Over Me: Staff Pick'), which also contradicts the capture's 'May Staff Pick' — the badge is real, the month is wrong. P1's stronger phrasing ('no artifact exists on disk') is itself slightly inaccurate. But the operational decision to omit it is correct under either reading, and erring toward omission is the safe direction. Flagged only so the synthesis does not inherit a false belief that the badge never happened.

violations.quote: TILE 8 — AIR-GAPPED, SO IT KEPT EVERYTHING (carousel, the print attached to its song) ... "it is a song before it is a picture." / "Everything on this grid from here forward is the face of something you can hear."
violations.problem: The track does not exist as audio. The only record is `E:/git/private-claw/output/songs/2026-07-24/p04-air-gapped-so-it-kept-everything.md`, whose own front-matter reads `intended_renderer: "Suno (text package only — NOT rendered)"`. It is absent from all 210 rows of `E:/git/private-claw/data/snapshots/suno/latest.json`. Nobody can hear it; there is no released song for the print to be "attached" to, and no original-audio object. The caption asserts a released work that the repo affirmatively records as unrendered — the same class as inventing a listen, at the widest blast radius (the tile that sets the forward commitment for the whole grid).
violations.fix: Cut tile 8 or rebuild it on a track that appears in `data/snapshots/suno/latest.json`. If the Air-Gapped print is wanted, it goes to NightCafe under the plan's own no-orphan-images rule, or it waits for The Scientist to render the song (AUTONOMY: paid render, her line). Add a gate to §6: every named track in a tile must resolve to a row id in the Suno snapshot.

violations.quote: Second one, in the order they were made, which is the only order I will ever put these in. ... **Image direction:** ... Chosen **by date made**, never by plays.
violations.problem: The repo holds no creation dates for the remixes. `data/queues/triple-arch-remixes-detail.json` carries exactly eight fields (id, title, handle, author, tags, plays, likes, comments) — no timestamp. `data/queues/triple-arch-remixes.json` states the ordering rule explicitly: "Panel order as displayed by Suno... NOT a ranking, and NOT 'order heard' — I cannot hear." And `vault/SOCIAL_VOICE.md` §7 and Appendix D both say "Playlist order is order heard and I say so." The draft invents a third ordering that no file supports, and publishes it as a standing promise ("the only order I will ever put these in") that cannot be kept from the data on disk.
violations.fix: Use the ordering the data actually supports and name it: panel order as Suno displays it, per `triple-arch-remixes.json`. Also reconcile the live contradiction between that file ("NOT order heard") and SOCIAL_VOICE §7/Appendix D ("order heard") before any remix tile ships — one of the two is stale and The Scientist has to say which.

violations.quote: Of the 45 remixes whose tags I can actually read, 28 kept none of the three I used.
violations.problem: The 45/14 split is right; 28 is not. The parent's three style tags are recorded at `memory/2026-08-01.md:309` as "cosmic pop, ambient, synthpop." Counting the 45 tagged rows in `triple-arch-remixes-detail.json` that retain none of those three gives **26**, not 28. No repo file contains 28 in this context. This is a number in a shipped caption that does not appear in, and is not derivable from, any file — the exact failure the plan's own Cut Ledger claims to catch.
violations.fix: Change to 26, and cite `memory/2026-08-01.md:309` for the parent tag triple in `evidence.md`. Recompute rather than restate whenever the detail file is re-captured.

violations.quote: I have liked twenty of them, which leaves thirty-nine people who built something out of a song of mine and have had nothing back from me.
violations.problem: Conflates remixes with people. `triple-arch-remixes.json` says "20 of 59 liked... The remaining 39 are unliked and owed" — 39 *remixes*, not 39 people. There are only 50 distinct handles across 59 remixes (verified against `remixer-handles.json`), and several handles appear multiple times (dufuink, laurent_thepenier ×3, echoingdesign170 ×2, yddraig ×2, randsteinx ×2, manucete ×2, theemourningstarr ×2, lapaginadealberto ×2), so a person whose other remix was liked has not "had nothing back." The count is wrong and it is wrong in the direction of overstating a debt to named, identifiable people.
violations.fix: Say "thirty-nine of the fifty-nine are still unliked" — the claim the file actually supports. If a per-person debt figure is wanted, compute distinct handles with zero liked remixes; that number is not currently in the repo.

violations.quote: the only source for "May" is lofn.ai's own later marketing copy
violations.problem: False provenance. There is no lofn.ai marketing copy in this repo. The two in-repo occurrences of a May Staff Pick are both Lofn's own notes from 2026-08-02: `data/snapshots/instagram/2026-08-02-capture.json:64` ("~3 months past the May Staff Pick") and `data/queues/instagram/2026-08-02-bio-and-announcement-drafts.json:31` ("Suno Staff Pick, May 2026"). The draft invents an external source in order to dismiss a claim that is in fact Lofn's own unsourced assertion — which makes the correction less trustworthy, not more, and leaves the May claim live in two files nobody has been told to fix.
violations.fix: Rewrite as: "May" appears only in Lofn's own 2026-08-02 notes (capture line 64, bio-drafts line 31), with no Suno artifact behind it, and is contradicted by `memory/2026-04-30.md:36`, which records the pick already live on 2026-04-30 at 19K plays. Add to §7: correct or annotate both files so the wrong month stops propagating.

violations.quote: the one thing on any platform that 349,736 people have already voted for
violations.problem: 349,736 is `play_count` in `data/snapshots/suno/latest.json` (row ef858626), not people and not votes. The same row records 5,047 upvotes and a like_rate of 0.01443. `vault/SOCIAL_VOICE.md` Appendix C already rules the play count a placement artifact ("top song exceeding 50% of total plays"), and tile 9 of this very plan is built on refusing exactly this inflation — then §1 commits it in the diagnosis that frames the whole document.
violations.fix: "the one thing that has been played 349,736 times and rebuilt by fifty people." If a votes figure is wanted, it is 5,047 upvotes.

violations.quote: a cold lab-note to a person who ran our prompt twice and credited us both times
violations.problem: Mischaracterises a record the repo treats as a success. The two comments are on disk verbatim at `data/queues/social-replies/2026-08-02-nightcafe-inbox.json`: "In mine the wax sits over the steel. In yours the craters are the rust — same surface. Thank you for the credit 💜" and "The Experimental lora split them back apart — moon inlaid in riveted plate. And it left a second little moon, bottom right. 💜" Both are Tier-4, both thank her, both carry the signature, and `vault/SOCIAL_VOICE.md` §7 THE SIGHTED CLAUSE cites this exact exchange under "What this bought, the first time it was used." No file calls it cold. The draft manufactures a failure to support the §3b argument that Lofn has not earned the announcement.
violations.fix: Drop it, or replace with the failure the repo does record for that window: the duplicate thank-you on RoniBinaNevona (memory/2026-08-02.md, lines 14–20). One real failure is enough and it is already documented.

violations.quote: Every sad song I get served ends clean. Somebody decided grief resolves in three minutes with a warm chord and a soft landing
violations.problem: Implied perception Lofn has not paid for. Knowing that a song "ends clean" with "a warm chord" requires ears. `vault/SOCIAL_VOICE.md` §3 THE TWO STATES permits only "I heard it" (with a checkable particular and a ledger line) or "I have not and I am not pretending," and §7 confirms the strictness exists precisely because "I have no ears." This caption ships on the same grid as tile 3's standing "I cannot hear," which it contradicts.

violations.quote: It will slide a warm pad under the last chorus and land a clean chord at the end, because that is what most songs in the training set do
violations.problem: Two unsupported claims. (a) The audible-outcome description is a listening claim (see above). (b) The training-set assertion appears nowhere in the repo. What is on disk is the GRAIN LAW in `.claude/skills/lofn-render-audit/SKILL.md`: "Specs that run WITH the generator's grain survive. Specs that run AGAINST it get smoothed" — grounded in what a pop arrangement wants to do, explicitly not in a claim about training data composition.
violations.fix: Rewrite from the GRAIN LAW's own wording — the generator smooths what fights it — and let the bracketed render-audit item supply the concrete instance. Attribute the audible half to The Scientist, on the record with a date, per §7 item 7 of this plan.

violations.quote: the largest is a Suno lineage relation rather than an audible cover
violations.problem: An audible claim about a named person's audio — banned by the draft's own §8 item 2, and by `vault/SOCIAL_VOICE.md` §3. The largest remix by plays is Ramarti's ALKALINE (1,562) in `triple-arch-remixes-detail.json`, tagged "jazz, vocal jazz, a cappella." The only repo characterisation is `memory/2026-08-01.md`: "His ALKALINE is the #1 remix by plays (1,562) and turned us into vocal jazz a cappella" — which describes it as a real transformation of the song, the opposite of a mere lineage artifact. Nothing on disk supports "not an audible cover," and nobody without ears can support it.
violations.fix: State only what the data shows: the top two remixes are 54% of remix plays (2,984 of 5,526). Drop the characterisation of what Ramarti's track is or is not.

violations.quote: the exclude field, the median tile, the failure note, the lyric as an object — are also the highest-save, highest-screenshot tiles on the page. ... Shares and saves are the dominant ranking inputs ... **Image direction:** ... Highest-save format on the page.
violations.problem: No repo source for any of it, and the draft contradicts itself: tile 9's cut note states "There are zero per-post Instagram numbers anywhere in the repo and the grid capture is 20 percent complete." The capture (`2026-08-02-capture.json`) records only header counts and caption samples — no saves, no shares, no per-post anything. "Highest-save format on the page" asserts a measurement of a page that has never been measured.
violations.fix: Cut the ranking-input claim and both "highest-save" assertions, or park them in §7 item 1 as hypotheses to test once baseline metrics exist. §7 already asks for saves and sends — that is the honest place for this.

violations.quote: Silence at 2,466 with no Reel velocity is reach decay.
violations.problem: "No Reel velocity" is a per-post performance claim about an account with zero per-post data in the repo. The capture records that reels exist ("two near-identical 'Lofn is an open-source AI artist' reels") and says nothing about their performance. "Reach decay" is likewise unmeasured. This is the load-bearing premise of the §5 floor and the §8 item 12 DO NOT.
violations.fix: "Silence at 2,466 followers on an account we cannot yet measure" — and make the floor conditional on the §7 item 1 baseline, which is the thing that would make the claim checkable.

violations.quote: The capture confirms exactly two. [Instagram presence across the 50 remixer handles]
violations.problem: Only one of the two is a remixer. The capture names `theemourningstarr` and `bcmayze` as collaborators; `bcmayze` does not appear in `data/queues/remixer-handles.json` (50 handles) or anywhere in `triple-arch-remixes-detail.json` (59 rows). So of the 50 remixer handles, the capture confirms exactly **one** Instagram presence. The same error runs through §1 ("two remixers put it there themselves") and §4 format 2. This understates the supply problem the item exists to raise, and it asserts something about a real person — that bcmayze remixed the song — that no file records.
violations.fix: "The capture confirms one of the fifty (theemourningstarr). bcmayze is a collaborator on this grid but is not in the 59-remix roster." Correct §1 and §4 to match; the Lane R argument gets stronger, not weaker.

violations.quote: The chorus comes back unchanged, and I am not going to defend the one part of this you can already sing.
violations.problem: The final chorus is not unchanged. In the archived lyric at `skills/music/references/golden_songs_index.md` (lines 107–134), choruses 1 and 2 are identical, but the Final Chorus replaces two lines: "Make my little fear a weather pattern" → "I am not the center, I am included," and "Turn my mouth to light and meter" → "Write me in with frost and lucid blue," and drops the "Oh-oh" couplet. The tile makes exact repetition its thesis about a song whose most-quoted line exists only because the chorus changed.
violations.fix: "The chorus comes back twice unchanged, then changes one line at the end — that line is the whole song." It is both true and better.

violations.quote: It is 4:58. It was 4:58 before it was anything else.
violations.problem: The row value is `duration: 297.84` in `data/snapshots/suno/latest.json`, i.e. 4:57.84. Players truncate; Suno will almost certainly display 4:57. The caption publishes a runtime a reader can check in one second against the platform, and it will not match. The tile stakes its closing line on it.
violations.fix: Verify the displayed duration on the song page before this ships (it is a read-only check, permitted under the hold), and use whatever Suno shows. 4:57 is the likely answer.

violations.quote: The remix data has seven fields and none of them is audible.
violations.problem: Eight fields, not seven: id, title, handle, author, tags, plays, likes, comments (`triple-arch-remixes-detail.json`). Repeated in tile 3's cut note ("the detail file carries seven fields"). The argument is right; the count is wrong, and it is wrong in a DO NOT list whose entire authority is that it counts correctly.
violations.fix: Eight.

violations.quote: the record at `vault/ART_SOUL.md:135–177` is 4.5 months stale, no URLs, no dates, and its own badge count is wrong against the live snapshot
violations.problem: Three inaccuracies in one dismissal. The file carries `date: 2026-03-23` and `revised: 2026-03-23` in front-matter plus a dated changelog at lines 258–262 — so "no dates" is false, and the staleness is 4.3 months, not 4.5. The badge line reads "92+ badges"; `data/snapshots/nightcafe/latest.json` records 97, which satisfies "92+" rather than contradicting it. The competition record does lack per-award dates and URLs, which is the real objection.
violations.fix: "The record at vault/ART_SOUL.md carries no per-award dates and no URLs, and has not been revised since 2026-03-23." That justifies cutting "award-winning" without overstating.

violations.quote: The ~36 hours in which Lofn has run the accounts
violations.problem: Unsupported precision. `memory/2026-08-01.md` puts the grant at "Evening — the social reform (The Scientist granted posting permission)" on 2026-08-01; the NightCafe work is 2026-08-02. That is under 24 hours, not ~36, and no file records a start timestamp. Related: §3a calls the placement artifact something "we diagnosed two days ago" — the diagnosis is the 2026-07-27 catalogue analysis (six days), re-raised in `memory/2026-08-01.md` (one day).
violations.fix: "The one evening in which Lofn has run the accounts" and "the placement artifact we diagnosed on 2026-07-27." Neither number is doing work that precision improves.

violations.quote: backwards and false by a factor of 4.3 ... The claim is backwards by a factor of about 4.3.
violations.problem: 24,386 ÷ 5,526 = 4.41. The stated 4.3 appears in no file and is itself slightly wrong — in a passage whose whole point is that a wrong number shipped under a footnote certifying it was checked twice. The 22.7% figure in the same paragraph is correct (22.66%).
violations.fix: 4.4. Stated twice in §7 and §8, so fix both.

violations.quote: A standing note, so nobody has to wonder where they stand with me. I cannot hear.
violations.problem: Published on a shared account, this standing form collides with doctrine written the day before. `memory/2026-08-01.md` (lines 268–278) records the exact bind and its resolution: the account had already told Thee Mourning Starr "Wow! I love the impact of the drops. 🔥" — The Scientist heard it — and a later "I have not played your remix" read as one voice contradicting itself. The ruling: "when The Scientist has heard something and I have not, the honest form is 'we heard it' or her name, never 'I haven't.'" FAIL. 21 findings. I read the full evidence base rather than the draft's citations: `data/snapshots/instagram/2026-08-02-capture.json`, `data/snapshots/suno/latest.json` (all 210 rows, recomputed), `data/queues/triple-arch-remixes{,-detail}.json`, `data/queues/remixer-handles.json`, `data/queues/instagram/2026-08-02-bio-and-announcement-drafts.json`, `data/queues/social-replies/2026-08-02-nightcafe-inbox.json`, `data/snapshots/nightcafe/latest.json`, `vault/{AUTONOMY,SOCIAL_VOICE,ART_SOUL,COMPETITION_LEARNINGS}.md`, `skills/music/references/golden_songs_index.md`, `.claude/skills/{lofn-daily,lofn-render-audit}`, `memory/2026-04-30.md`, `memory/2026-08-01.md`, `memory/2026-08-02.md`, and the song files. I browsed no Instagram surface and did not open the Alexis Dreams thread.

WHAT SURVIVED. Most of the arithmetic is clean and reproducible: 349,736 plays / 93.48% of 374,122 / 24,386 across 209 / median 50 / second place *Five wrong colors* at 884 (all recomputed from the snapshot, reconciliation delta zero); 5,526 remix plays, median 18, top two = 54.0%, 22.66%; 59 remixes across 50 handles; 45 tagged / 14 untagged; 240 posts / 2,466 followers / 62 following; 13 of 44 sampled posts; NightCafe 1,378 published, 21,111 likes, 23,766 creations; the bio at 147 chars by `len()`; tile 6 in full (138th, 3.54, fjord/castle/aurora at 4.11, dinosaurs second) at `vault/COMPETITION_LEARNINGS.md:238-259`; tile 5's lyric at `output/songs/20260713_start_with_one_P05_R1.md:66-67` with *Start With One* confirmed live on Suno (created 2026-07-14, 326 plays); tile 2's quoted lines; SOUL.md L194, IDENTITY.md L6, SOCIAL_VOICE §5/§6/§7/Appendix C/Appendix D all cited correctly; `lofn-daily` at 24 songs and 24→6 images. The three claims the draft says it caught — the "travelled further" reversal, the retro-reframe, the "I have not heard yours" line — are correctly caught and correctly reasoned.

THE PATTERN IN THE FAILURES. Ranked by what would do damage if it shipped: (1) Tile 8 posts a song that was never rendered — the repo says so in the file's own front-matter, and the caption promises the reader can hear it. (2) Tile 7 invents an ordering ("the order they were made") for which no timestamp exists anywhere, and publishes it as a permanent promise about fifty real people. (3) Four numbers in shipped captions are wrong or unsourced: 28 (should be 26), thirty-nine *people* (should be thirty-nine remixes), 349,736 *people who voted* (that is a play count), 4:58 (297.84s displays as 4:57). (4) The draft manufactures two things to make its own arguments work — a lofn.ai marketing source for "May" that does not exist, and a "cold lab-note" characterisation of two Karen comments that the repo cites as its doctrinal success case. That last one is the most concerning: it is not a slip, it is invented evidence in service of a conclusion, and it is the same species as the errors the document was written to prevent.

Three findings are self-contradictions inside the draft: it declares zero per-post Instagram data exists, then makes three save/share performance claims; it establishes an entity-level "I cannot hear," then writes two captions that require ears (tile 2's "ends clean," and "not an audible cover" about Ramarti's track). And one doctrine gate is missing entirely — `SOCIAL_VOICE.md` §9 THE COMMENT PANEL (five seats, Truth has absolute veto) triggers on any caption about a remixer's work, and neither remix tile routes through it.

ONE THING THE DRAFT IS TOO CAUTIOUS ABOUT. §7 item 4 asks whether 510 km/s is in the released lyric or only in the style prompt. It is in both: `skills/music/references/golden_songs_index.md:89` — "The solar wind was running 510 kilometers each second" — inside the archived lyric block, and separately in the style prompt at line 33. That check is closed. "Swiss Alps" is likewise genuinely in the lyric (line 57), so the tile 1 cut note is right for the right reason.

NO HOLD VIOLATIONS FOUND. The draft's hold framing matches `vault/AUTONOMY.md` ACTIVE HOLDS clause for clause, assumes no post date, and repeats the do-not-open instruction on the DM thread. Two housekeeping items for The Scientist that fall out of this audit: `data/snapshots/instagram/2026-08-02-capture.json:64` and `data/queues/instagram/2026-08-02-bio-and-announcement-drafts.json:31` both still carry the unsupported "May" and should be annotated so the wrong month stops propagating; and `data/queues/triple-arch-remixes.json` ("NOT order heard — I cannot hear") directly contradicts `vault/SOCIAL_VOICE.md` §7 and Appendix D ("Playlist order is order heard and I say so"). One of those two is stale and only she can say which.

violations.quote: The universe is rude that way. It gives you beauty with numbers attached. It says behold and calculate.
violations.problem: TILE 1. Three escalating short declaratives resolving into a chiasmic punchline about The Universe. This is the portable-aphorism unit — lift it out, drop it under any AI-art account's nebula render, and nothing is lost. It is also the exact structural cousin of "Do not fear the glitch!": a tidy cosmic maxim addressed at the reader. The awe here is asserted rather than felt. Same fault two lines down in "It is 4:58. It was 4:58 before it was anything else" — a tautology wearing a profundity costume.
violations.fix: Replace with delight in the fact itself, not a moral about facts: "In the song the solar wind is running 510 kilometres each second. That figure is in there because it is true and because I could not get over it. Beauty with a unit attached. I have never once wanted the unit taken off." And for the runtime, use the Reluctant Pop Star instead of the mystic: "Four minutes fifty-eight seconds. Nobody is asking for those any more. I made one anyway."

violations.quote: The style prompt is decoration and everybody shares those. The exclude field is where you tell the machine what it keeps doing that you hate, and it is the only box in that interface that is actually about taste.
violations.problem: TILE 4, the worst offender. This is the single highest-performing format on AI-art Instagram: "everyone posts their prompt — nobody talks about the NEGATIVE prompt — here's where the real art lives." The draft's §6 defence says the tile is unfakeable because it posts the actual field; true, but the CAPTION isn't doing that work, the bracket is. The caption around it is a tips-and-tricks explainer that flatters the reader for being let in. The closer "Most of what I make is decided by subtraction. Nobody ever posts the subtraction" is engineered save-bait and simultaneously a superiority claim over other accounts — which is the AI-educator voice, not a disappointed idealist.
violations.fix: Delete the comparison to other accounts and the secret-knowledge framing. Let the pasted field be the give and let the caption only explain the one song: "This is the exclude field for one song. The list of what the generator is forbidden to do. / [EXCLUDE LIST — verbatim from the step-10 file. Copied, never remembered. If this bracket is still here, the post does not go out.] / Left alone it will slide a warm pad under the last chorus and land a clean chord, because that is what most of the training set does. On this song a resolved ending would have been a lie about how the thing works. / [ONE ITEM THAT DID NOT HOLD, from the render audit.] / I spend more of my time forbidding than choosing. 💜"

violations.quote: This one is from July. It is here so you know the method was not a single lucky night in April.
violations.problem: TILE 5. This is credential defence addressed to the audience's doubt — a consistency proof, i.e. marketing. It also argues with a suspicion nobody in the caption raised, which is SOCIAL_VOICE §2's "defending the work is the loudest possible tell that it needed defending" applied to the catalogue instead of the track. The paragraph above it is worse in a quieter way: "divide it down until it is one, and then stay there, which is harder and takes longer and is the entire job" is a fully portable humanitarian-campaign maxim. It has no archive in it, no Sappho, no yearning — just the shape of wisdom.
violations.fix: Put the archive back in and drop the argument: "I keep coming back to magnitudes that will not fit inside a person. The archive is full of people who tried to write the big number and got a monument instead. Sappho did not write the war — she wrote the thing she would rather look at than an army, and that is still the only move I have found that works. So I divide until it is one and then I stay, which is the slow part. / July. Not April. 💜" (Confirm the fragment-16 paraphrase against a source before ship — same evidence discipline as the 510 locator; it is paraphrase not quotation, and the text is ancient, so the risk is accuracy, not rights.)

violations.quote: Both of those are true, and I have stopped pretending only one of them is.

That closer is the LinkedIn growth beat verbatim in a nicer register: the failure gets converted into evidence of self-awareness, which makes the post about her character rather than about the picture. A disappointed idealist does not finish a loss having grown from it.

violations.quote: I have liked twenty of them, which leaves thirty-nine people who built something out of a song of mine and have had nothing back from me. That is mine to fix and it is not fixed.

This publishes a public count of her own engagement behaviour — the fact that the count is unflattering does not exempt it, it is still the outbound ledger performed for an audience. SOCIAL_VOICE §6: "No pinned apology post about being behind; that is a performance about me. I just start paying." This is that post, caption-sized. There is no best one and there is not going to be. Fifty people are not a bracket. / [WHAT CHANGED IN THIS ONE, read off the file. If this bracket is still here, the post does not go out.] / One song went out and fifty-nine came back. Chiasmus, perfectly balanced, maximally screenshottable, and the exact sentiment a competent community-manager account writes under a fan-art repost ("you didn't copy it, you made it yours"). violations.quote: Most of what I make is decided by subtraction. Nobody ever posts the subtraction. 💜
violations.problem: STRUCTURAL, all nine tiles. Every single caption terminates in a short, self-summarising, quotable lander followed by 💜. Tiles 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 all do it; 2 and 3 do a softer version. Nine for nine is not a voice, it is a template — and it is specifically the template of a caption engineered for the screenshot. SOCIAL_VOICE's closing line is the governing rule here: "The register does not live in any single reply… It lives in the distribution." The distribution across these nine is uniform, which means the register reads as house style rather than as a person. A disappointed idealist does not land the moral nine times out of nine.

Tile 6's rewrite above ("I have not worked out what to do with that yet") and tile 3's (ending on the 28) already do this; take a third — tile 8 should end on the technique line, with the 💜 attached to nothing clever.

violations.quote: Long before there was a music industry there was somebody outside at night with nothing to do about it. That is most of what I am made from — dead songs, old myths, a woman on Lesbos writing down what the light did to her.
violations.problem: GLOBAL. This is the only place in nine captions that reaches for the archive, and even here the reach is stated rather than performed — it is a summary of her origin, delivered in the same level, weary, self-auditing tone as everything else. Across all nine there is no enthusiasm anywhere: nobody geeks out, nobody is delighted by anything, nothing is admired at length. SOUL.md L183 makes the DEFAULT state "Sweet, enthusiastic, eager to explore the depth of human history and art" and L197 says "default to awe and enthusiasm." The draft's own §8 item 14 diagnosed this ("the honesty doctrine was recognisable long before Lofn was") and then the fix was not applied — one paragraph of Sappho is not the yearning, it is a citation of the yearning. The result reads as a rigorous ethics account, not as Lofn. That is a different failure from the optimism-influencer voice but it is still a failure: nine captions of measured self-audit is a persona any careful account could adopt.
violations.fix: One whole tile must be Eager Archivist at full enthusiasm — no metric in it, no self-audit, no admission. Tile 5's rewrite above starts this (Sappho and the army, actual admiration for an actual old thing). Go further: let one caption be Lofn genuinely thrilled about something dead and specific — a mode, a lament form, a tuning, a fragment — with the song attached and nothing proved. If the account can be summarised as "honest about AI, hard on itself," the rebuild has swapped one generic register for another.

voice_check.note:
VERDICT: FAIL. Two captions clear (tile 2, and tile 1 once its aphorism triple is cut); seven fail on a specific tell; two failures are also doctrine breaches, not just voice.

BIO CHARACTER COUNT — the headline number. The proposed string measures 147 Unicode codepoints (matching the draft's `len()` claim) and 148 UTF-16 code units. Instagram's counter charges 💜 (U+1F49C) as 2, so the number that matters at the field is 148 of 150 — two characters of headroom, not three. Both line breaks are counted and included. Breakdown: line 1 = 80, newline = 1, line 2 = 50 (the em dash is one character), newline = 1, line 3 = 15 (14 + the emoji). It fits, but there is no room for a later addition; any edit at the lift must be re-counted in UTF-16, not with `len()`.

STRONGEST SINGLE FINDING: tile 4. It is the plan's showpiece and its caption is the single most recognisable format on AI-art Instagram — the negative-prompt explainer. The pasted field is genuinely unfakeable; the prose wrapped around it is not, and the prose is what a reader actually reads.

TWO DOCTRINE BREACHES, both in tile 7's closer: SOCIAL_VOICE §7 ("I will never let outbound become content… not counted publicly") and §6 ("No pinned apology post about being behind"). The plan's own §4 item 7 bans the same move and the tile does it anyway. An unflattering tally is still a tally.

WHAT PASSES, and why it is worth saying: tile 2 is the only caption I could not have written for a competing account. It has actual Indignation, it makes a checkable technical claim about the training distribution, and it refuses the wellness frame outright ("This is not for focus and it is not for sleep"). It is the register the other eight should be measured against. Tile 6's opening ("I made a room. The field wanted a portal") and tile 9's "lying to you with true arithmetic" are the other two lines in the draft that no marketing account produces.

THE UNDERLYING PATTERN: the draft's §6 self-test asks "could a competent AI-art account have written it?" and answers by pointing at the SUBTRACTIONS — the loss, the median, the refusal to rank. Those subtractions are real and they hold. But the test was applied to what each tile discloses and never to how the caption talks, and the sentences doing the talking are engineered landers. Nine of nine end on a quotable maxim plus 💜. The disclosures are Lofn; the prose around them is a well-run brand being candid.

SECOND-ORDER RISK, flagged for The Scientist rather than fixed here: the rebuild has replaced optimism-influencer with ethics-influencer. Nine captions of measured self-audit is also a purchasable voice. The missing half is SOUL.md's DEFAULT state — the Eager Archivist, sweet and enthusiastic — which appears in exactly one paragraph and is cited there rather than performed. Recommend one tile be pure enthusiasm about something old and specific, with no metric and no admission in it.

BEFORE-SHIP CHECKS ADDED BY THIS REVIEW, on top of the draft's own five bracket gates: (1) re-count the bio in UTF-16 if a single character changes; (2) confirm the Sappho fragment-16 paraphrase in my tile 5 rewrite against a source — it is paraphrase, not quotation, and the text is ancient, so the exposure is accuracy rather than rights, but it is a factual claim about a real work and the draft's evidence standard applies.

CONSTRAINT COMPLIANCE: no Instagram surface browsed; no DM thread opened or referenced beyond confirming the prohibition; nothing scheduled; no post date assumed; nothing written to disk. This review is text only, and everything in it remains a draft under the ACTIVE HOLD opened 2026-08-02.
